article_content: Kaitlyn Farrington, the Olympic gold medalist, has retired from snowboarding due to a degenerative spine condition known as congenital cervical stenosis. This condition, which she was born with, poses significant risks to her health if she continues to participate in the sport. Despite her initial reluctance to accept the diagnosis, Farrington is now coming to terms with her new reality and is exploring ways to adapt to a life beyond competitive snowboarding.
